provenance.method: Compare member paths after removing container roots and compare every member byte

trace: Webapp init calls pxt.winrt.initAsync; file activation reads selected file and unpacks HEX project source.
WinRT deploy writes compiler output firmware to removable device folders matching the configured board drive filter.
WinRT serial uses a target-configured name filter to open serial devices and post serial output to editor listeners.
CLI server validates the local token before filesystem/deploy APIs and names token-protected WebSocket routes.
CLI gdb writes an OpenOCD extended-remote localhost:3333 script and launches ARM GDB.
Bundled tdast implements TouchDevelop AST conversion and runtime compilation; eval initializes generated user scripts.
Decoded Base64 includes micro:bit fonts, note frequencies, SVG artwork, editor metadata and a MicroBitTouchDevelop.h include. Unicode decoding recovers source/tutorial text.
Electron updater fetches configured release metadata, downloads an installer, and launches it on quitAndInstall; ordinary visible updater behavior.

shared_rule_review.consumers: All exact IDs and ancestor selectors inspected. The sole broad SSH selector recognizes tooling/transcripts; added members supply the same SSH evidence. No broad consumer for the moved CAV3RN or task selectors.
shared_rule_review.cav3rn: Four word matchers, size, platform, type scope and WinMD exclusion retained; only neutral placement and labeling changed. Three-name family threshold retained. No original CAV3RN fixture present in allowed sample/testdata corpus.
shared_rule_review.ssh: Endpoint and -L matchers retained byte-for-byte. OpenOCD reproduces the unsupported mining inference; tunnel is now a notable SSH capability. Mining composite and masquerade consumer keep their original conjunctions via the relocated ID.
shared_rule_review.task_selectors: Raw command/task substring proximity can match ordinary DOM attribute switches or CLI subcommands. Neutral branch matchers now require comparison/case syntax. Python command-field selector queries retained. Existing mesh agent attack findings unchanged; synthetic four-verb BOF roster retained.
shared_rule_review.additions: AppX windows.fileTypeAssociation activation declaration; comment and wrong-category controls.

limitations: Static review; source provenance verified but no guarantee about future remote editor content or an actual machine deployment.
